description:
A series of loop trails that total over 30 km in length are found just minutes north of the community of Tatla Lake. Experience the breathtaking beauty and solitude of the vast Chilcotin wilderness as you ski. Trails are usually groomed and track-set from mid-November to mid-March, depending on weather and snow conditions. Dog-friendly trails are also available for your furry companions. The Tatla Lake Ski Club also frequently host bonfires and lunch on Sundays. Follow the Tatla Lake Ski Club on Facebook for more information on current ski conditions and upcoming events.

INDIGENOUS TERRITORY: Tatla Lake is situated within the traditional and unceded territory of the Tsilhqot'in (pronounced "sil-ko-teen") Nation. The Tsilhqot'in name for this place is "Tatl'ah". Source: https://tsilhqotin.ca
directions: From Williams Lake follow Hwy 20 about 225 km west to the community of Tatla Lake. Just past the store in Tatla Lake, turn north at the Health Center onto W.R. Graham Road and follow about 3 km to the trailhead.
